caption:
Copy my girls’ trip with @Brockville_Tourism! #BrockvillePartner

Brockville is one of my favourite spots to visit with the girls or my family. Whether we’re heading there for a quick day trip (it’s only an hour from Ottawa) or turning it into a weekend getaway, there’s always something new to explore. Brockville has the perfect mix of adventure, relaxation, unforgettable experiences, and delicious food, something for everyone!

Save this post for your next trip to Brockville as I’m sharing my full itinerary with you from places to stay, top activities, and places to eat!

💙 @maisonmaitland offers a hands on cooking class lead by a professional chef! You get to cook your meal from scratch using fresh ingredients and learn different cooking techniques. 
💙 Widows Peak BnB offers three individual suites each with their own ensuite bathroom. You can rent a room or the entire three bedrooms which would be perfect for any girls or family trip. They have a large patio and turret with panoramic views of the St. Lawrence River.
💙 @brockvilletunnel walk along Canada’s first railway tunnel and experience the light and sound installation in person. This is the perfect spot for photo ops and to walk along the waterfront.
💙@themillrestaurantbrockville is located in an old stone mill and has incredible Italian and Mediterranean inspired dishes. The cozy environment and elevated meals is the perfect spot for dinner.
💙 @richardscoffee located in Downtown Brockville, this cafe offers fresh coffee, tea, baked goods and hearty breakfast options. You can grab & go or sit down in their cozy space.
💙 Kayak & Paddleboad rentals are located at St. Lawrence Park and is the perfect activity to explore the shoreline and Thousand Islands region. You could easily spend all day here as they also have picnic tables, bathrooms, and a restaurant.
💙 @anthophilecafe is located next to the kayak rentals. Enjoy lunch and lemonade while surrounded by florals and stunning views of the river.

Next time you’re searching for a unique spot to explore, visit Brockville and follow along to see more of our recent trip!

#BrockvilleTourism #Brockville #OttawaMoms

I wanted a dental clinic that eased my nerves while offering advanced technology for the best possible care. I appreciated how they really take their time with new patients. We began with x-rays of my teeth and guided biofilm therapy, which is an advanced cleaning to remove plaque. 🪥It’s more comfortable than traditional teeth cleanings and has impeccable results! 

I also did a full Dental Exam and Invisalign Consultation where they created 3D images of my teeth showing simulations using photos and videos with my face. I’m a visual person so this was ideal to see how my smile would look if I chose @Invisalign or veneers! 

Finishing with Zoom Teeth Whitening to brighten my coffee loving teeth. ☕️The whole experience was comfortable as they had pillows, headphones, blankets, and Netflix! I didn’t feel much sensitivity during the treatment but did have sensitivity a few hours after so I recommend keeping your evening plans light. By the next morning I was back to normal, just with a brighter smile. 😁
